question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A heavy round plate of metal thrown by an athlete.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Discus**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**Discus**'.
 
• It means 'a heavy round flat object that is thrown as a sport'. (खेल में इस्‍तेमाल होने वाला चक्‍का, डिस्‍कस)
 
 
• *Example: He was the first place in the **discus** throw. *

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Discus.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Spear**: a long pole with a sharp point at one end, used for hunting or fighting. (भाला, बरछी, शूल)
 
• **Hammer**: a tool with a heavy metal head that is used for hitting nails, etc. (हथौड़ा)
 
• **Javelin**: a long stick with a pointed end that is thrown in sports competitions. (खेल स्‍पर्धाओं में फेंका जाने वाला भाला)
